synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis + holed 3x3-block pieces (x=row); A1-A4 move selection by one block (axis rows only; pieces blocked by bounds/other pieces); A5 cycles axis -> pieces largest-first -> axis.
Render layers wall<target<reflection<piece then re-extract; unselected wall centres are transparent, selected wall 0 centres solid; walls/players = comps of own colour + all 0 cells ranked by bbox.
Step-64 mechanic: budget bar drains 1 per non-undo action after 64 counted actions (h=min(64,128-n)); spent cells form one extra comp ranked first among players, so pieces shift 0,1 -> 1,2.
A7 = undo last successful move (positions restored, selection kept, no budget cost); action count and undo stack are continuity-gated hidden state.
Unconfirmed: why spent cells rank first among players only (assumed key (0,63)); whether blocked moves/A6 cost budget. Stateless fails only steps 64 and 70.
